question: Umbuzo
defaultDirections: Khetha impendulo ocinga ukuba iphendula umbuzo. Xa ugqibile, cinezela {checkAnswer}. Uza kufumana ingxelo ebonisa ukuba impendulo yakho ichanekile na kwaye uqhubeke njani.
relatedContentDescription: Oku kwenza indawo esongiweyo yomxholo onxulumene nalo mbuzo kwaye ihlala iboniswa
hintDescription: Oku kuboniswa ukuba umsebenzisi uyiphosile impendulo
evidenceDescription: Oku kuboniswa ukuba umsebenzisi uyifumene ichanekile impendulo
numericDirections: Chwetheza inani. Iyunithi iboniswa wena. Xa ugqibile, khetha {checkAnswer}.
withinPercent: Iimpendulo ezingaphakathi kwe-{tolerance}% yexabiso elichanekileyo ziyabalwa.
withinAbsolute: Iimpendulo ezingaphakathi kwe-{tolerance} yexabiso elichanekileyo ziyabalwa.
notSetUp: Lo mbuzo awukabi nayo impendulo esetiweyo.
formulaHelp: Inani, okanye ifomula esebenzisa izinto eziguquguqukayo ezingezantsi, umzekelo d / (t / 60). Iifomula zingasebenzisa + - * / ^, izibiyeli, sqrt() kunye ne-abs().
tokensHelp: Bonisa into eguquguqukayo kumbuzo ngokubhala igama layo kwizibiyeli ezigoso, umzekelo {d}.
keyProblem: Oku akunakusonjululwa okwangoku. Jonga ukuba igama ngalinye kwifomula liyinto eguquguqukayo.
